product_one_liner.value: Marquee unifies club and external football data and applies each club's sporting DNA to produce decision-ready insights for professional clubs' recruitment, squad planning, and analysis teams.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes the platform's data-unification and football decision-support use cases.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation and footer list product, about, FAQ, news and demo links, but no pricing link; the site directs visitors to book a demo.

named_customers.notes: Both clubs are identified as using Marquee as their official intelligence layer.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn shows 19 employees, placing the company in the 11-20 band.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn gives New York, NY as headquarters; Preqin specifies New York, US.

founded_year.notes: LinkedIn lists Marquee as founded in 2025.

eng_blog.notes: The news index includes two detailed technical/product-model articles: one by the CTO on the platform's architecture and one by the co-founder and Chief Data Scientist on the Squad Fit model.

public_docs.notes: The homepage navigation/footer has no documentation or help link; the site has an FAQ page, but not a multi-article documentation portal.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live Senior AI Scientist posting was updated November 3, 2026.

model_provider.notes: The product, FAQ, technical/news and security pages describe proprietary AI/ML models but do not name an underlying AI model or provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The company states that it completed a SOC 2 Type II audit.

last_funding.notes: The July 30 report identifies a $4M seed round; Marquee's July 30 release states $6.5M total funding, consistent with $4M seed plus earlier pre-seed funding.

raised_18mo.notes: The seed round was announced July 30, 2026, within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The job board lists one open Marquee role, Senior AI Scientist, and no SDR, BDR or account executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: On July 14, 2026 Marquee announced that SkillCorner users could access new Physical and Game Intelligence data through the product, within the six months before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: A company LinkedIn post dated September 13, 2026 says Yuval Foox joined Marquee as VP Data & AI, within the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable job posting and FAQ name no CRM or sales/marketing system.
